score_semantics: Official service, downloaded-byte lineage and runtime measurement confidence only; result confidence is reported separately.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry INSPIRE anonymous download catalogue and authority ZIP packages
verified_facts: An anonymous session returned the complete official catalogue after the first redirect established session cookies
The Enfield, Havering and Lambeth ZIP packages were downloaded from catalogue-discovered links
ZIP and extracted GML byte lengths and SHA-256 hashes were recorded before parsing
semantic_limits: A catalogue row alone is not a parcel match
Only a unique native EPSG:27700 point-in-polygon match may identify the exact polygon

candidates.name: HM Land Registry native INSPIRE GML PREDEFINED parcel schema
verified_facts: The GML feature collection uses LR:PREDEFINED records with GEOMETRY, INSPIREID, LABEL and NATIONALCADASTRALREFERENCE fields
All three authority GML files declare urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::27700
Each exact canonical Point was covered by exactly one native polygon
semantic_limits: INSPIRE polygons are indicative extents and not title plans
No geometry is inferred when a point has zero or multiple covering polygons

candidates.name: HM Land Registry INSPIRE OGC WMS capabilities
verified_facts: WFS is disabled and the cadastral WMS layer is not queryable
semantic_limits: The WMS is a visualisation service and not the polygon source for numeric sampling
The downloaded authority GML remains the exact-geometry source
